entries.name: Fuselage
entries.description: A versatile, procedural fuselage section. Customize its shape, size, and corner style to build sleek, modern aircraft bodies.

entries.name: Nose Cone
entries.description: A procedural nose cone. Adjust its length, shape, and roundness for optimal aerodynamics and style.

entries.name: Hollow Fuselage
entries.description: A procedural hollow fuselage section. Customize its shape, size, and thickness.

entries.name: Glass Fuselage
entries.description: A procedural hollow fuselage section made of glass. Customize its shape, size, and thickness.

entries.name: Curved Fuselage
entries.description: A procedural curvy fuselage section. Customize its shape, size, and thickness.

entries.name: Hole
entries.description: Carve a customizable opening into fuselage parts to create cargo bays, bomb bays, wheel wells, and more. Only works with fuselage parts.

entries.name: Window
entries.description: Install customizable window into any fuselage part. Only works with fuselage parts.

entries.name: Straight Block
entries.description: Sometimes people don't want smooth blocks. If you are that kind of person, then this block is for you.

entries.name: Angled Block
entries.description: If used in the right place, this can improve the aerodynamics of your airplane.

entries.name: Block
entries.description: The basic building block. Snap these together to build the body of your airplane.

entries.name: Sphere
entries.description: A ball is the most wonderful toy of all.

entries.name: Hemisphere
entries.description: Sometimes you don't need a whole sphere. Sometimes you just need half of a sphere.

entries.name: Primary Wing
entries.description: A procedural main wing with a control surface to coast the skies in style.

entries.name: Horizontal Stabilizer
entries.description: A smaller version of the procedural wing to help you control your pitch.

entries.name: Vertical Stabilizer
entries.description: A smaller version of the procedural wing meant to go vertical to help you fly straight like an arrow.

entries.name: Delta Wing
entries.description: A procedural delta wing with an efficient airfoil, ready for speed!

entries.name: Base Wing
entries.description: One-size-fits-all wing part that can mould to any wing shape size!

entries.name: Standard Flap
entries.description: The simplest control surface. Can deflect up and down

entries.name: Fowler Flap
entries.description: A flap that slides backwards as well as deflecting, increasing the wing's surface area when it is deployed.

entries.name: Brake Flap
entries.description: A flap that can act as a normal control surface, until the brake input is activated and it splits in two to become an airbrake.

entries.name: Slat
entries.description: A surface on the leading (front) edge of the wing, that slides forward and down, increasing lift for takeoff and landing.

entries.name: Ultra Turbofan
entries.description: Essentially a giant ducted fan that happens to have a jet engine hidden inside. It sips fuel and can push an obscene amount of mass, but good luck finding enough ground clearance under your wings to mount it.

entries.name: Large Turbofan
entries.description: A fuel-efficient high-bypass engine made for standard-sized airliners and big transports.

entries.name: Medium Turbofan
entries.description: A compact high-bypass turbofan engine for smaller, regional jets.

entries.name: Military Jet
entries.description: A high-performance low-bypass engine built for speed. Features a variable nozzle and an optional afterburner for supersonic dashes. Perfect for fighters and interceptors where raw thrust matters more than fuel economy.

entries.name: Radial Prop
entries.description: It's big, it's torque-y, and it's great for those classic, WW2 style birds. Has the aerodynamics of a barn door.

entries.name: Large Prop
entries.description: High-performance, liquid cooled V-engine built for speed and it even supports a supercharger if you need an extra boost.

entries.name: Small Prop
entries.description: Compact and lightweight engine, well suited for small aircraft.

entries.name: Prop Assembly
entries.description: Give it a fast spin and it will pull ya where you want to go.

entries.name: Small Turboprop
entries.description: A compact gas turbine that drives the powertrain through a reduction gearbox.

entries.name: Medium Turboprop
entries.description: A workhorse gas turbine that holds constant RPM while the propeller does the talking. Bolt four onto a big wing and go haul something.

entries.name: Large Turboprop
entries.description: The biggest turbine we make that still turns a propeller. Enough shaft power to demand contra-rotating props and your full attention.

entries.name: Large Heli Rotor
entries.description: A main rotor assembly for a helicopter.  It produces a lot of torque when it generates lift, so make sure to slap a tail rotor on as well.

entries.name: Small Heli Rotor
entries.description: A small main rotor assembly for a helicopter.  It produces torque when it generates lift, so make sure to slap a tail rotor on as well.

entries.name: Tail Rotor
entries.description: Attempts to counteract torque from a helicopter rotor assembly, and provides yaw control

entries.name: VTOL Engine
entries.description: This engine produces thrust which is channelled to VTOL Nozzles for vertical take-off and landing maneuvers.

entries.name: VTOL Nozzle
entries.description: Powered by VTOL Engines. Power is evenly spread across all VTOL Nozzles. Carefully place these so that the Center of Thrust is near your airplane's Center of Mass, or you will have a lot of trouble hovering and transitioning to forward flight.

entries.name: VTOL RCN
entries.description: Reaction Control Nozzles (RCN) are used to control the aircraft in a hover. The larger VTOL Nozzles provide the main thrust to get off the ground, and these little nozzles help to make sure you don't crash n' burn.

entries.name: VTOL Inlet
entries.description: Large inlet that can suck in enough air for any jet engine. It works better when placed near the front where the air is less turbulent.

entries.name: VTOL Slim Inlet
entries.description: Inlets help suck air in so jet engines can breathe. Most engines will need at least two of these slim inlets.

entries.name: Fuel Tank
entries.description: Gimme fuel, gimme fire, gimme that which I desire.

entries.name: Exhaust
entries.description: A single exhaust pipe. Attach it to any engine and it emits whatever that engine is burning. Place several to build a set of headers or a collector ring — the engine splits its gas between all of them, so eight pipes each puff an eighth rather than eight times the smoke.

entries.name: Tiny Engine
entries.description: A small I2 engine, perfect for motorbikes or other small vehicles.

entries.name: Economy Engine
entries.description: A Swiss Army knife, a daily driver with the perfect balance between efficiency and performance.

entries.name: Sports Engine
entries.description: A roaring V8 sports engine.

entries.name: Racing Engine
entries.description: A high performance racing engine, ready to push you to the craziest top speeds.

entries.name: Semi Truck Engine
entries.description: A massive heavy duty V8 engine so you can carry the weight of the biggest cannon you can fit.

entries.name: Drive Shaft
entries.description: The backbone of a powertrain. Use these to connect powertrain components like engines, transmissions, and differentials together.

entries.name: Transmission
entries.description: Manages the engine's power with multiple gears. Adjust its gearing to create a trade-off between quick acceleration and high top speed. Has a built-in clutch.

entries.name: Gearbox
entries.description: Transfers rotational power through the powertrain. Use the gear ratio to trade torque for RPM and tune performance.

entries.name: Gearbox Offset
entries.description: Transfers rotational power through the powertrain. Use the gear ratio to trade torque for RPM and tune performance.

entries.name: Gearbox Long
entries.description: Transfers rotational power through the powertrain. Use the gear ratio to trade torque for RPM and tune performance.

entries.name: Gearbox Large
entries.description: Transfers rotational power through the powertrain. Use the gear ratio to trade torque for RPM and tune performance.

entries.name: Right Angle Gearbox
entries.description: Never argue with a gearbox with a 90-degree angle. It's always right.

entries.name: Transfer Case
entries.description: A specialized differential that splits power between the front and rear axles, allowing for dynamic FWD, RWD, and AWD configurations using the VTOL slider.

entries.name: Differential
entries.description: One drive shaft as an input and two drive shafts as output. It's like a fork in the road for a drive shaft.

entries.name: Racing Wheel
entries.description: High performance on asphalt, but try not to touch grass with these.

entries.name: Street Wheel
entries.description: Offers a good balance between performance and style.

entries.name: Offroad Wheel
entries.description: Aggressive treads designed to chew through mud and climb mountains.

entries.name: Double Wishbone
entries.description: Makes the wheel bounce up and down, improves traction and handling. Only works with wheels.

entries.name: Coilover
entries.description: Shocks are useful when you want to soften impact with terra firma.

entries.name: Wheel Assembly
entries.description: Multi-wheel assembly. Pick a style for the wheel layout (single, dual, quad, …), then a tire and rim that gets applied to every wheel in the assembly. Attaches directly to the body for a fixed mount, or to a gear leg to retract.

entries.name: Gear Bay
entries.description: Cuts a wheel well into your fuselage and fits doors that open and close with the landing gear. Gives retractable gear a place to tuck away.

entries.name: GA Bent
entries.description: A small, springy cantilever strut.

entries.name: Aero
entries.description: A streamlined light-aircraft leg with a faired wheel pant. Low drag for slow, sporty flyers.

entries.name: A-Frame
entries.description: A rugged A-frame bush leg on a fat balloon tire. Built for rough fields and backcountry strips.

entries.name: A-Frame Bare
entries.description: The A-frame bush leg stripped to a bare frame. Same rough-field grit, a little lighter.

entries.name: Ivan
entries.description: A rugged V-frame nose leg with a long piston strut, styled after heavy Eastern-bloc jets.

entries.name: Hollow
entries.description: A slightly lighter nose leg with a hollowed strut.

entries.name: Braced
entries.description: A braced V-frame nose gear fitted with a launch bar.

entries.name: Forged
entries.description: A nose leg with a solid strut.

entries.name: Airliner Front
entries.description: A tall twin-wheel nose gear for airliners and large jets.

entries.name: Airliner Rear
entries.description: A heavy airliner main gear riding a triple-wheel bogie. For the big birds.

entries.name: Stout
entries.description: A short, stout main leg on a four-wheel bogie. Squat and strong for heavy loads.

entries.name: Heavy
entries.description: A heavy-duty main leg on a four-wheel bogie. Built to haul serious weight.

entries.name: Tripod
entries.description: A tripod-braced main leg with a scissor strut. A stable, fighter-style mount.

entries.name: Beefcake
entries.description: A beefy main leg with long suspension travel and a fat tire. All muscle on rough landings.

entries.name: Lever
entries.description: A lever-action main leg with long suspension travel for soft, springy touchdowns.

entries.name: Trailing Link
entries.description: A trailing-link main leg whose linkage soaks up bumps for smooth landings.

entries.name: Wing
entries.description: A compact wing-mounted main leg that folds up thin, perfect for tucking under slim wings.

entries.name: Arresting Hook
entries.description: Catches on arresting cables. Maybe if you use this you can finally manage to land on that carrier, despite your piloting skills?

entries.name: Catapult Connector
entries.description: Tells an aircraft catapult where to connect to your plane, defines catapult acceleration and target launch speed. Not strictly required for catapult connection.

entries.name: Hawk Eye
entries.description: Your eyes in the sky when precision matters. This targeting pod not only directs your laser-guided love letters with pinpoint accuracy but also comes equipped with a high-zoom camera, allowing you to watch your handiwork unfold from a safe distance. Essential for those who like to keep an eye on the prize.

entries.name: Hawk Eye Lite
entries.description: Just like the Hawk Eye, but a smaller, lighter variant with a little less range.

entries.name: IR Missile
entries.description: A simple yet effective Infrared seeking missile with a wide FoV for short range fights.

entries.name: SAR Missile
entries.description: A fast mid-range Semi-Active Radar missile, don't let anyone run away from you.

entries.name: AR Missile
entries.description: A very agile mid-range Active Radar missile, perfect to make your enemies panic while all their alarms go off.

entries.name: Laser Missile
entries.description: A fat laser guided missile to bring the annoyance of trolling with a laser pointer to a whole new level, remember to bring a targeting pod.

entries.name: ARD Missile
entries.description: A mid-range Air to Ground Anti-Radiation missile with mounted wings, to smack targets in style.

entries.name: Jet Missile
entries.description: A massive air breathing missile with extremely long range. Why? You may ask. Why not.

entries.name: Unguided Missile
entries.description: A dumb missile that flies as straight as it can, kinda like a rocket.

entries.name: Procedural Missile
entries.description: The ultimate in customizable ordnance. This modular missile body is the foundation for your own unique creation. Build anything from a nimble dogfighting missile to a long-range cruise missile.

entries.name: Missile Fins
entries.description: Fins that can go on missiles for function, for fun, or for both.

entries.name: Missile Details
entries.description: Cosmetic details that don't affect the physics of the missile, but can make it look more neato.

entries.name: Fin Details
entries.description: Cosmetic details that don't affect the physics of fins, but can make it look more neato.

entries.name: Missile Wings
entries.description: Wings specially designed for missiles to give them a little extra lift. Goes together with missile jet engines like lamb and tunafish.

entries.name: Missile Jet Inlet
entries.description: Inlets specially designed for missiles with jet engines.

entries.name: Boom 25
entries.description: It's a 250-pound dumb bomb. It goes boom when it hits something.

entries.name: Boom 50
entries.description: 500-pound dumb bomb. It makes a bigger boom.

entries.name: Lazy 50
entries.description: This is a laser-guided bomb with 500lbs of love.

entries.name: Torpedo
entries.description: Self-propelled weapon with an explosive warhead. Drop it into the water and it will go boom if it touches anything.

entries.name: Tank Cannon
entries.description: A customisable tank cannon with mighty shells.

entries.name: Auto Cannon
entries.description: An explosive round autocannon to tear apart anything that decides to step in front of you.

entries.name: Pirate Cannon
entries.description: YARR! Behold this mighty boom‑barrel! It can't hit a lazy kraken, but by the Brown Pearl, if it clips ye, ye'll be floppin' like a drunken gull!

entries.name: Minigun
entries.description: The minigun has a higher rate of fire, but it must shut off briefly every three seconds so the barrels don't overheat.

entries.name: Wing Gun
entries.description: A respectable cannon with a slim design that fits nicely inside of wings.

entries.name: Rocket Pod
entries.description: Holds seven 2.75-inch rockets and can be very effective against ground targets, as long as the pilot has the skills.

entries.name: Pylon
entries.description: Standard hardpoint for attaching weapons and fuel tanks under wings. Includes a built-in detacher for when it's time to release the payload.

entries.name: Long Pylon
entries.description: Longer version of a pylon. Nothing special about it.

entries.name: Flares
entries.description: Dispenses chaff or flares when triggered, for helping evade missiles and break locks.

entries.name: Chaffs
entries.description: Dispenses chaff or flares when triggered, for helping evade missiles and break locks.

entries.name: Basic Seat
entries.description: A simple seat for a cockpit or interior.

entries.name: Modern Seat
entries.description: A chunkier seat destined for something sportier.

entries.name: Car Seat
entries.description: A sporty seat designed for cars. Features adjustable reclination for those moments when you just need to kick back.

entries.name: MFD
entries.description: Multifunction display unit for easy system control from the cockpit and adding that extra high-tech look.

entries.name: Gauge
entries.description: An instrument panel gauge used to display a piece of information (such as altitude or airspeed).

entries.name: Attitude Indicator
entries.description: An instrument panel indicator that shows your pitch and roll on a ball-shaped device. Is bigger on the inside than the outside, warranty void if opened.

entries.name: Label
entries.description: Label part, to add text or numbers. Supports inputs.

entries.name: Joystick Base
entries.description: A part that forms the base of a joystick, or any other control. Any parts that are on the physics body that is connected to the top of this become part of the control and can be grabbed in VR.

entries.name: Basic Joystick
entries.description: A simpler-looking grip object with a hand pose, and a trigger that you can rebind.

entries.name: Modern Joystick
entries.description: A modern-looking grip object with a hand pose, and a trigger that you can rebind.

entries.name: Yoke
entries.description: A two-handed control for pitch and roll, common in light/medium aircraft.

entries.name: Steering Wheel GT
entries.description: A modern, GT-style steering wheel for high-performance cars. Functionally identical to the standard steering wheel, but with a sportier look.

entries.name: Steering Wheel
entries.description: A classic steering wheel for ground vehicles. Connect its input to 'Roll' for conventional steering.

entries.name: Cylinder Grip
entries.description: A simple grippable cylinder object with symmetric hand poses.

entries.name: Gas Pedal
entries.description: Car throttle pedal with a wall-mount base.

entries.name: Brake Pedal
entries.description: Car brake pedal with a wall-mount base.

entries.name: Clutch Pedal
entries.description: Car clutch pedal with a wall-mount base.

entries.name: Floor Mounted Pedal
entries.description: Car pedal with a floor-mount base.

entries.name: Fighter Throttle
entries.description: An ergonomic fighter-jet-style throttle control.

entries.name: Push Throttle
entries.description: A simple general aviation-style throttle that can be mounted directly to the instrument panel.

entries.name: Basic Lever
entries.description: A simple lever that can be bound to any control.

entries.name: Vintage Lever
entries.description: A simple lever that can be bound to any control.

entries.name: Handy Lever
entries.description: A simple lever that can be bound to any control.

entries.name: Ergonomic Lever
entries.description: A simple lever that can be bound to any control.

entries.name: Switch
entries.description: An interactable switch that performs some action when toggled.

entries.name: Button
entries.description: An interactable button that performs some action when used.

entries.name: Flight Computer
entries.description: A part that can act as the main cockpit of a craft without taking up a lot of space or having a cockpit camera view.

entries.name: Canopy
entries.description: It's a canopy for your own cockpit.

entries.name: Blocked Canopy
entries.description: It's a canopy for your own cockpit.

entries.name: Modern Frame
entries.description: It's a clean slate to create your own cockpit.  This version has side rails to attach parts, and comfortable foot-holes to rest your feet.

entries.name: Basic Frame
entries.description: It's a clean slate to create your own cockpit.

entries.name: Decal
entries.description: A part for projecting a decal/sticker onto your aircraft.

entries.name: Text Decal
entries.description: A part for projecting a text-based decal onto your aircraft.

entries.name: Beacon Light
entries.description: Simple light that you can color however you like and they can also flash.

entries.name: Formation Light
entries.description: Simple light that you can color however you like and they can also flash.

entries.name: Hinge Rotator
entries.description: Rotate parts around a hinge.

entries.name: Small Rotator
entries.description: Slimmer version of the rotator.

entries.name: Rotator
entries.description: Special little block that can rotate stuff that's attached to it. It's really neat.

entries.name: Piston
entries.description: Push parts away from each other with a customizable hydraulic piston.

entries.name: Winch
entries.description: Rotating drum that extends and retracts a durable cable. Works great with a magnet attached to the end of its cable.

entries.name: Magnet
entries.description: Turn it on with an activation group and this powerful electromagnet will stick to anything that has even the slightest hint of metal inside of it.

entries.name: Refuel Drogue
entries.description: A part that can be towed by a large aircraft on a winch in order to give fuel to other aircraft.

entries.name: Refuel Probe
entries.description: A part for taking fuel from a fuel tanker. Any part can take fuel from a refuel drogue, but this part will tell the drogue where the probe is, so the assist mode will work.

entries.name: Detacher
entries.description: Use these to drop missiles, a mini aircraft, or create an ejection seat for last-second bailouts. Select a detacher and click the part options icon to change which group it is assigned to.

entries.name: Gyroscope
entries.description: A control moment gyro that is capable of providing powerful torques to keep your design upright.

entries.name: Parachute
entries.description: These are great when you want to rapidly slow things down.

entries.name: Air Brake
entries.description: Sometimes slowing down can be tough, but these can really help with that.

entries.name: Camera
entries.description: Special camera that can give you a different view from your plane. Check the Part Properties for several features.

entries.name: Orbit Camera
entries.description: This is a magical 'camera' that gives you the ability to orbit the camera around different parts of your plane. Don't worry about its ugly appearance, it will disappear when you start flying.

attributes.name: id
attributes.label: ID
attributes.description: Unique integer identifier for this part within the craft. Changing this breaks craft loading if the new ID is invalid or matches another part.

attributes.name: partType
attributes.label: Part Type
attributes.description: The part type identifier. Changing this breaks part connections and may fail to initialize or break craft loading.

attributes.name: position
attributes.label: Position
attributes.description: World-space position of this part.

attributes.name: rotation
attributes.label: Rotation
attributes.description: World-space Euler rotation of this part.

attributes.name: disableAircraftCollisions
attributes.label: Disable Aircraft Collisions
attributes.description: If true, this part will not collide with other parts on the same craft.

attributes.name: health
attributes.label: Health
attributes.description: Hit points for this part. Defaults to the part type's base health.

attributes.name: centerOfMass
attributes.label: Center of Mass
attributes.description: Local-space center-of-mass offset. Defaults to the part type's value.

attributes.name: calculateDrag
attributes.label: Calculate Drag
attributes.description: If false, drag is not calculated for this part.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.label: Scale
attributes.description: Non-uniform scale applied to this part.

attributes.name: massScale
attributes.label: Mass Scale
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the part's calculated mass.

attributes.name: dragScale
attributes.label: Drag Scale
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the part's calculated drag.

attributes.name: partCollisionResponse
attributes.label: Collision Response
attributes.description: Controls how this part reacts to collisions: whether it can disconnect, explode, or neither.

attributes.name: dragType
attributes.label: Drag Type
attributes.description: Overrides the drag calculation method for this part. 'Default' inherits from the part type.

attributes.name: name
attributes.label: Name
attributes.description: Display name shown in the designer for this part.

attributes.name: materials
attributes.label: Materials
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of material slot indices assigned to this part.

attributes.name: visibleInDesigner
attributes.label: Visible In Designer
attributes.description: If false, this part is hidden in the designer.

attributes.name: symmetryDisabled
attributes.label: Symmetry Disabled
attributes.description: If true, this part is excluded from symmetry operations.

attributes.name: style
attributes.label: Style
attributes.description: Shape category of the fuselage. Determines whether it is solid, hollow, a cone, etc.

attributes.name: colliderType
attributes.label: Collider Type
attributes.description: Overrides the collider generation strategy. Omit to use the default for this fuselage style.

attributes.name: noseconeRoundness
attributes.label: noseconeRoundness
attributes.description: Roundness of the nosecone tip. Only applies to cone-style fuselages.

attributes.name: autoResize
attributes.label: autoResize
attributes.description: When true, the fuselage auto-resizes to match connected parts.
